citations.excerpt: At the time of the Reformation in the 16th century Finland was part of the kingdom of Sweden.

facts.value: The Lutheran church of Finland, which regards itself as the successor of the pre-Reformation church there. It received its own church law and assembly in 1869.

citations.excerpt: The Evangelical Lutheran Church regards itself as the natural successor of the church that existed in Finland before the Reformation.
new legislation in 1869 created a distinction in principle between the two, in that the church received its own ecclesiastical law and church assembly.

facts.value_before_verify: The established Lutheran church of Finland, which sees itself as continuing the pre-Reformation church there. It received its own church law and assembly in 1869.
